comment: Hand-written. Work packages: the units in which open mechanics are planned and closed. size is S (up to 3 sub-tasks), M (4 to 8), L (9 to 20), XL (more, or a new subsystem) or null when the package is named only; hard lists the packages without which it cannot be implemented, evidence those needed before it can be verified; state is planned, active or closed, and a package is closed only after its hard prerequisites. A mechanic that is not implemented names its packages in its own file; a package with a mechanics list takes only the mechanics listed. tools/compat_ledger.py refuses unknown ids and a closed package that an open mechanic still names, and generates compatibility/PACKAGES.md.
